supporting_pages.title: "Advanced query insights features overview \_|\_ AlloyDB for PostgreSQL \_\
evidence_snippets: To help you proactively identify and troubleshoot root causes of query performance issues, advanced query insights features let you do the following: Perform ad hoc analysis to diagnose difficult problems using near real-time query stats and correlation analysis across multiple dimensions like users, hosts, and databases.

Based on the previous seven days of Query Insights data, you can monitor query performance at the application level and trace the source of problematic queries across the application stack by action, controller, framework, route, application, and database driver.
In addition, standard query insights metrics are available in system metrics in Cloud Monitoring to keep the functionalities of the standard query insights intact.
